cards.ex: I finally landed a job after months of searching!
cards.exUz: Men nihoyat bir necha oylik qidiruvdan so'ng ishga joylashdim!
cards.uzDef: Ish topmoq, yangi ishga kirmoq degani. Muaffaqiyatli ish topish.

cards.ex: If you don't take breaks, you'll burn out quickly.
cards.exUz: Agar siz tanaffuslar qilmasangiz, tezda charchab qolasiz.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari ishlash natijasida jismoniy va ruhiy charchoq.

cards.ex: He's been working hard to climb the ladder at his company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyasida mansab pillapoyasidan ko'tarilish uchun qattiq mehnat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Karyerada yuqoriga ko'tarilish, lavozimda o'sish.

cards.ex: It's getting late, let's call it a day.
cards.exUz: Kech bo'lyapti, keling, ishni tugatamiz.
cards.uzDef: Kun uchun ishni to'xtatish, ishni yakunlash.

cards.ex: He got the sack for being late too often.
cards.exUz: U juda tez-tez kech kelgani uchun ishdan haydaldi.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan bo'shatilish, ishdan haydalish.

cards.ex: Everyone needs to pull their weight on this project.
cards.exUz: Bu loyihada har bir kishi o'z hissasini qo'shishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Guruhda adolatli miqdorda ish bajarish.

cards.ex: We need to think outside the box to solve this problem.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni hal qilish uchun biz standartdan tashqari o'ylashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va ijodiy g'oyalar bilan o'ylash.

cards.ex: I don't want to stay in a dead-end job forever.
cards.exUz: Men abadiy istiqbolsiz ishda qolishni xohlamayman.
cards.uzDef: Kelajagi yo'q, rivojlanish imkoniyati bo'lmagan ish.

cards.ex: We'll play it by ear and see what happens.
cards.exUz: Biz vaziyatga qarab harakat qilamiz va nima bo'lishini ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan rejalashtirmasdan, vaziyatga qarab harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She always goes the extra mile for her clients.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'z mijozlari uchun qo'shimcha harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Talab qilinganidan ko'proq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I work best under pressure.
cards.exUz: Men bosim ostida eng yaxshi ishlayman.
cards.uzDef: Stress holatida, ko'p talablar ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: We need to tighten our belts during this recession.
cards.exUz: Biz bu retsessiya davrida kamarlarimizni mahkam bog'lashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish, tejamkorlik qilish.

cards.ex: You need to be able to think on your feet in this job.
cards.exUz: Siz bu ishda tez fikrlay olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tez va samarali qarorlar qabul qilish.

cards.ex: There's a steep learning curve when you start this job.
cards.exUz: Bu ishni boshlaganingizda tez o'rganishingiz kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va qiyin o'rganish jarayoni.

cards.ex: Don't cut corners on safety, it's not worth it.
cards.exUz: Xavfsizlikda yo'lni qisqartirmang, bunga arzimaydi.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq yoki arzonroq bo'lish uchun sifatga zarar yetkazish.

cards.ex: The project failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi, shuning uchun biz boshidan boshlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Reja ishlamasa, yangidan boshlash.

cards.ex: The bottom line is that we need to increase sales.
cards.exUz: Asosiy natija shundaki, biz savdoni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Eng muhim fakt yoki natija.

cards.ex: Let's get down to business and start the meeting.
cards.exUz: Keling, ishga kirishamiz va uchrashuvni boshlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Ishni boshlash, muhim narsalarga e'tibor qaratish.

cards.ex: We need to make sure everyone is on the same page.
cards.exUz: Har bir kishi bir xil fikrda ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bitta narsa haqida bir xil tushunchaga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes at a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda sir-asrorlarni o'rganishga vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ish yoki faoliyatning asoslarini o'rganish.

cards.ex: She's a real go-getter, always looking for new opportunities.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy harakatchan, doim yangi imkoniyatlarni izlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun faol harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: It's hard for small businesses to stay afloat during a recession.
cards.exUz: Kichik bizneslar uchun retsessiya davrida suvda qolish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda yashashni davom ettirish, bankrot bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: Let's pencil in a meeting for next week.
cards.exUz: Keling, kelasi haftaga uchrashuvni vaqtinchalik rejalashtiramiz.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtinchalik rejalashtirish, aniq vaqt belgilamasdan.

cards.ex: We need some blue-sky thinking to come up with new ideas.
cards.exUz: Yangi g'oyalar bilan chiqish uchun bizga chegarasiz fikrlash kerak.
cards.uzDef: Amaliy cheklovlarsiz ijodiy fikrlash.

cards.ex: Job security is important to many people.
cards.exUz: Ish xavfsizligi ko'p odamlar uchun muhim.
cards.uzDef: Ishni yo'qotmaslik ishonchi.

cards.ex: We need to raise the bar for customer service.
cards.exUz: Biz mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish standartlarini oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Standartlarni yuqoriroq qilish, talablarni kuchaytirish.

cards.ex: It's hard to get your foot in the door in this industry.
cards.exUz: Bu sohada imkoniyatga ega bo'lish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada imkoniyatga ega bo'lish, ilk qadamni qo'yish.

cards.ex: We need to cut through the red tape to get things done.
cards.exUz: Ishlarni bajarish uchun biz byurokratiyani yengishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz qoidalar va jarayonlar.

cards.ex: I need a change of pace, this job is too stressful.
cards.exUz: Menga hayot tarzini o'zgartirish kerak, bu ish juda stressli.
cards.uzDef: Hayotdagi odatiy tartibni o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: What are your salary expectations for this role?
cards.exUz: Bu lavozim uchun sizning maosh umidlaringiz qanday?
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilmoqchi bo'lgan maosh miqdori.
